posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 to 10 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper haunch and hindquarter area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a spiral, lyrate curvature, extending posterodorsally before curving inward toward the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is 1.8 times the pixel width of the basal circumference of a single horn.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal mane (crest) along the spine and a distinct white facial chevron visible on the bridge of the muzzle.
